answer: Identity is a radio licence. A callsign takes a proctored exam; two transmitters on one callsign cancel it. Each epoch the seed names a band, a minute and a timber mast serial on site. The seat sends a signed burst; three receivers triangulate a fix within 30 km of the licence address. Replay one recording from one shed and the cluster gets one fix, one vote, and a 70,000 POA forfeit apiece. Rig, exam and practice cost $300 a seat: $300,000 before a farm sees a payout. A raven imitates a dozen voices yet perches in one tree; the zephyr carries each call from a place, never a name.
